howTo.title: How do I share my Liked Music?
howTo.step1: 1. On music.youtube.com, open Library → Liked Music.
howTo.step2: 2. Select the songs (tap one, then tap the others).
howTo.step3: 3. Choose "Add to playlist" → New playlist, and set visibility to Unlisted or Public.
howTo.step4: 4. Open the new playlist, tap Share → Copy link, and paste it here.
howTo.anyPlaylist: Any public or unlisted playlist of songs you love works too, e.g. your party or workout mix.

spotifyExport.intro: Spotify can send you your whole listening history. It takes them a few days, so start now and we will take it from there.
spotifyExport.step1: Request your data at spotify.com/account/privacy. Tick Account data (ready in about 5 days) and Extended streaming history (up to 30 days): Extended has your whole history.
spotifyExport.step2: We'll remind you when it should be ready.
spotifyExport.reminded: Done. We'll remind you in about 5 days, and again in 25.
spotifyExport.denied: Notifications are off for Nomad Karaoke. Turn them on in Settings to get a reminder.
spotifyExport.step3Ios: When Spotify's email arrives, save the zip to Files, then come back here and pick it.
spotifyExport.step3Android: When Spotify's email arrives, download the zip, then Share → Nomad Karaoke, or come back here and pick the file.

appleGuide.intro: No Apple Music subscription? Apple can still send you your play history. It takes them a few days.
appleGuide.step1: Go to privacy.apple.com and sign in.
appleGuide.step2: Choose Request a copy of your data, tick Apple Media Services information, and submit. Apple emails you in a few days.
appleGuide.step3: Download the files, then pick the zip or the Play Activity CSV here.

oauthError.missing_params: ListenBrainz didn't send back everything we need. Please try again.
oauthError.invalid_state: That sign-in expired or was already used. Please try again.
oauthError.exchange_failed: We couldn't finish connecting to ListenBrainz. Please try again.
oauthError.validate_failed: Your MetaBrainz account isn't on ListenBrainz yet. Sign in at listenbrainz.org once, then try again.
oauthError.generic: Something went wrong connecting ListenBrainz. Please try again.

lastfm.intro: Enter your Last.fm username and we'll read your scrobbles to find songs you know.

permissions.microphone: Allow Nomad Karaoke to hear you sing so it can measure your vocal range. Audio stays on your phone.

voice.title: Your voice
voice.intro: Find a quiet spot. Sing "laaa". Takes about a minute.
voice.introPrivacy: Audio stays on your phone. Only the notes you hold are saved.
voice.lowPrompt: Slide down to the lowest note you can hold comfortably
voice.highPrompt: Now slide up to the highest note you can hold comfortably
voice.singHint: Optional. About 15 seconds of any song helps find your comfortable middle.
voice.holdHint: Hold a steady note until it lights up.
voice.lowGot: Got it. Go lower if you can, or tap Done.
voice.highGot: Got it. Go higher if you can, or tap Done.
voice.singing: Keep singing. We'll finish by ourselves.
voice.keyboardLabel: Keyboard with the notes you held
voice.noNotesTitle: We couldn't hear a held note
voice.noNotesBody: Move somewhere quieter, hold the phone in front of you and sing one steady "laaa".
voice.micDeniedBody: We need the microphone to hear the notes you sing. Audio stays on your phone.
voice.micBlockedBody: Turn on the microphone for Nomad Karaoke in Settings, or pick your voice type instead.
voice.confidenceHigh: High confidence: lots of steady notes across a wide range.
voice.confidenceMedium: Medium confidence. Try again somewhere quiet for a sharper read.
voice.confidenceLow: Low confidence: we heard only a few notes. Try again for a better read.
voice.confidenceSelf: From your pick, not measured. Take the mic test for a closer match.
voice.saveSignIn: Sign in to save it to your profile.
voice.saved: Saved. Discover will use it to find songs that fit your voice.
voice.selfBody: Pick the closest one. You can take the mic test any time for a closer match.
